boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, visually documentable destinations on nearby Toledo corridors, each with one sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Toledo Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Monroe Street entrance to explore the museum’s open galleries; check the current museum map before choosing a gallery route.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission art stop on Monroe Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists its location at 2445 Monroe Street and states that general admission is free; some galleries are temporarily closed for renovation.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday; consult the museum’s current visit page for gallery availability and hours.

cards.title: Glass Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Cross Monroe Street to see the pavilion’s glass architecture and watch the listed daily 2 p.m. glassblowing demonstration when available.
cards.short_summary: Glass collection and working demonstrations across Monroe.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Museum of Art lists the Glass Pavilion at 2444 Monroe Street and says it offers free glassblowing demonstrations every day at 2 p.m.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Enter during Toledo Museum of Art public hours; confirm demonstration availability before traveling.

cards.title: Center for the Visual Arts
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause outside the Center for the Visual Arts to photograph Frank Gehry’s V-shaped building before continuing along the museum campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Museum of Art identifies the Center for the Visual Arts as a 1992 design by Frank Gehry and describes its V-shaped plan toward Monroe Street.
cards.source_title: Campus & Architecture | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: View from public museum grounds during campus visiting hours.

cards.entity_name: Toledo Museum of Art Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Toledo Museum of Art Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the museum grounds between buildings and look for the exterior artworks in the sculpture garden before crossing Monroe Street.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor art integrated into the museum campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s campus description identifies a sculpture garden composed of exterior objects of art on its grounds at 2445 Monroe Street.
cards.source_title: Campus & Architecture | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Use public museum grounds and follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Old West End Neighborhood
cards.subtitle: Collingwood Boulevard to Glenwood Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take a self-guided look at the historic streetscape from public sidewalks, keeping homes private and using the tour material for context.
cards.evidence_claim: Destination Toledo places the Old West End Neighborhood from Collingwood Boulevard to Glenwood Avenue, and its self-guided tour describes 25 city blocks of historic houses.
cards.source_title: Old West End Self-Guided Historic House Tour
cards.access_notes: View residential architecture only from public rights-of-way; do not enter private property.

cards.title: Rudolph Bartley House
cards.subtitle: Collingwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Add this 1855 Collingwood Boulevard house to a sidewalk architecture walk and use the tour’s style notes to identify its Chateau-inspired design.
cards.short_summary: A named stop on the Old West End tour.
cards.evidence_claim: Destination Toledo’s Old West End self-guided tour lists the Rudolph Bartley House at 1855 Collingwood Boulevard and identifies it as a 1905 Chateau-style structure.
cards.source_title: Old West End Self-Guided Historic House Tour
cards.access_notes: Private residence; appreciate it from the public sidewalk only.

cards.title: Mott Branch
cards.subtitle: Dorr Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring a study task and claim a quiet study room or table during open hours; the branch also lists maker-space equipment and meeting rooms.
cards.short_summary: A library stop with quiet study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Mott Branch at 1010 Dorr Street lists quiet study rooms and tables, maker-space equipment, and free self-serve meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: Mott | Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: The branch lists Monday–Thursday hours of 9 a.m.–8:30 p.m., Friday–Saturday 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m., and Sunday closure.

cards.title: Smith Park
cards.subtitle: Dorr Street corridor
cards.notes: Pair a Dorr Street library visit with a brief outdoor reset across the street at Smith Park, then return to the branch for your next task.
cards.short_summary: The park directly opposite the Mott Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Lucas County Public Library states that its modern Mott Branch was constructed directly across the street at Smith Park.
cards.source_title: Mott | Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Use normal public-park access and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Middlegrounds Metropark
cards.subtitle: Ottawa Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow the walk/bike path along the Maumee River and stop at the kayak cove or Rotary Roundhouse area without leaving marked park routes.
cards.short_summary: Riverfront path space beneath the Anthony Wayne Bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: Metroparks Toledo lists Middlegrounds at 111 Ottawa Street with a half-mile of river frontage and a 1.5-mile walk/bike path.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7 a.m. until dark.

cards.title: Glass City Metropark
cards.subtitle: Front Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Front Street and use the riverfront park for a daylight walk; orient first with the listed entrance addresses and park map.
cards.short_summary: A Front Street riverfront park with multiple entrances.
cards.evidence_claim: Metroparks Toledo lists Glass City Metropark entrances at 815, 1001, and 1505 Front Street and describes the park as part of the Glass City Riverwalk.
cards.access_notes: Park grounds are listed as open 7 a.m. to dark; individual amenities may have separate conditions.
